spec.name: Fluxomatic WS cabinet (black-window build)
spec.dimsBasis: Ratios least-squares fitted to 8 photo corners (W/H 0.76, D/H 0.34, plinth/H 0.09); absolute scale assumes a standard 800 mm tall enclosure body (610x800x275 body on 75 mm black L-channel feet). Louvre grilles and isolator handle add ~12-32 mm per side.
